title.narrative: Emergency Support for IDPs in the Northwest of Myanmar

description.narrative:
ltpgtltspan style="color: black font-family: Arial, sans-serif"gtThe project “Emergency Support for IDPs in the Northwest of Myanmar” targets conflicts and cyclone MOCHA affected 24,033 people from 32 displaced sites of three townships (Magway: Saw, Sagaing: Kani Myaung) starting from September 2023 to June 2024 (10 months). The project specifically targets hard-to-reach townships, the highest humanitarian gaps, and prevents the accumulation of unmet needs and reliance on negative coping mechanisms. The project is led by Network Activities Group together with three local CSOs namely (i) Light for Lives (L 4 L), (ii) Thukha Myay Rural Development Association (TKMRD), and (iii) Mahuyar Unity Association (MUA). The project will work on multi-sectoral approaches covering (i) Food Security, (ii) WASH, (iii) Shelter and Non-Food Items (NFI), and (iv) Protection. lt/spangtltbrgtlt/pgt
ltp style="margin-bottom:9.95pttext-align:justify" class="MsoNormal"gtltspan style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif color: black"gtThere are two main activities under Food Security led by NAG Cash for Food assistance to 24,033 people from 32 camps for 15 days food ration and Multi-purpose Cash Assistance to 1,274 person (PWD and PLW) from 32 camps as 15 days ration. There are five main activities under WASH led by CSOs (i) 20 Water collection tanks for 1,090 households from 10 camps of Saw townships, (ii) Hygiene kits for 2,307 households from 32 camps, (iii) Latrine bowls and pipe sets for 525 households of 12 camps from Saw townships, (iv) 2 times of Hygiene promotion ToT training to 35 person and, (v) Hygiene Promotion awareness campaign for 5,769 persons from 32 camps. Two shelter activities led by CSOs (i) cash assistance for shelter renovation to 2,076 households from 32 camps and (ii) NFI kits for 1,993 households from 32 camps. Four activities under protection led by CSOs (i) five key protection ToT trainings (2 days) for 75 person, (ii) five key protection awareness campaigns for 5,769 persons from 32 camps, (iii) unconditional cash grants for survival assistance for 56 survivors, (iv) multi-mobility aid assistance to 435 PWD from 3 townships. lt/spangtlt/pgt
ltp style="margin-bottom:9.95pttext-align:justify" class="MsoNormal"gtltspan style="color: black font-family: Arial, sans-serif"gtThe Cash and Voucher Assistance (CVA) will be prioritized and guided by market analysis, availability of cash, and reduce protection risks. To understand the market and local situations, consultation has done with three local CSOs, then they conducted the need assessment with the affected people. The project design is based on the outcome of consultation with affected people, dedicated complaints and feedback mechanisms will be installed to ensure access by all people. All the project activities will be specifically designed to include disabled persons' engagement, participation, and decision enable to remove barriers and improve access. Gender Equity is at the heart of our interventions, promoting participation, and create space and opportunity to take up leadership positions. The EORE is one of the mainstream explosive ordnance risk education in line with the HRP strategy and ICCG guidelines.lt/spangtlt/pgt
ltpgtltspan style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif color: black"gtThe project office will be set up in Magway, NAG will play key roles in project management and coordination while local CSOs will play key roles in implementation. NAG will coordinate with other implementing partners to avoid overlap, reduce gaps and find synergy. The project is designed to inform and train project staff, committee and local CSOs on various safeguarding principles including gender, inclusion, disability, PSEA, and other social environmental issues. The project will conduct safety and security assessment and market assessment to guide the possibility of cash-based programming, in-kind assistance will be considered if cash-based programming is not possible. NAG acknowledges fluidity, complexity and changing context, and we will review and update risk matrix and mitigation plan as needed.lt/spangtlt/pgt
